endangerment.comment:
Picard (3276-pcd) = Vulnerable (60 percent certain, based on the evidence available) (A few children learn the language, and
the future of Picard seems slightly less bleak than that of other Oi'l languages of
France. It is nevertheless severely endangered.) [Salminen 2007](cldf:salminen:07:2)
